context: A big gap-down on 24 Sep, then continuous selling on all three indices -- "a big fall" -- so he reads SELLERS as seated in the market.
plan: THE FLAT BRANCH FLIPPED BACK FROM 24 SEP: last night a flat open meant SELL, to hunt seated buyers. Tonight the seated side is SELLERS, so a flat open means BUY. Carrying last night's flat branch forward inverts it.
FLAT TO GAP DOWN -> BUY: identify buying-side setups to TARGET the sellers seated after 24 Sep's big gap-down and continuous selling.
A GOOD GAP UP -> SELL, WITH THE MARKET: a good gap up lets the sellers run early, so their SLs are no longer near and nobody gets to target them; follow the selling already under way.

WITH THE MARKET MEANS WITH THE SELLING, NOT THE GAP: a GAP_UP verdict selects SELL here, not the OPENING DRIVE gap-up long. He says a GOOD gap up; a marginal positive open is the flat case, which buys.
